purpose: Re-evaluate the two remaining historical-flux source requirements with a 35-mode public-equation provenance matrix and an exact symbolic normal-form comparison of Pan's two published (4,3) higher-spin representations.

historical_fidelity_criterion.rule: A requirement passes only when the pinned public primary sources uniquely prescribe the historical algebra. Agreement with implementation source, a binary oracle, NR data, or a conditional frontend is not selection evidence.

bohe.citation: Bohe et al., Phys. Rev. D 95, 044028 (2017), arXiv:1611.03703v3, Sec. II.B, Eqs. (4)-(9)

taracchini_2012.citation: Taracchini et al., Phys. Rev. D 86, 024011 (2012), arXiv:1202.0790v2, Sec. II.B and Appendix A

taracchini_2014.citation: Taracchini et al., Phys. Rev. D 89, 061502 (2014), arXiv:1311.2544v1, factorized-waveform discussion following Eq. (2)

pan.citation: Pan et al., Phys. Rev. D 83, 064003 (2011), arXiv:1006.0431v2, Eqs. (28g), (29g), (41g), Secs. III-V, and Appendices B-C

din.citation: Damour, Iyer, and Nagar, Phys. Rev. D 79, 064004 (2009), arXiv:0811.2069v2, Secs. II-IV and appendices

bfh.citation: Buonanno, Faye, and Hinderer, Phys. Rev. D 87, 044009 (2013), arXiv:1209.6349v2, Eqs. (52)-(53)

matrix.complete_selector_rule: Every expected mode must have all four decision fields explicitly selected by a pinned primary source. A cross-reference is sufficient only when it identifies one algebraic prescription.

rho43_symbolic_check.resolved_rule: The requirement passes only if the forms agree through the published spin order and the later model papers explicitly select one of the two finite-frequency normal forms. The selected form must be reported even though their first difference is beyond the published order.

clean_room_exclusions: Do not inspect, copy, or translate LALSimulation source.
Do not query a LALSimulation binary oracle.
Do not use agreement with native frontends or NR data to choose a historical branch.
